messages:
Priya (CSM): Quick heads-up on Skyline account -- onboarding trends show p95 latency drifting up and token spend higher than plan. Thinking we should propose a short pilot: quantized build + compact variant for tail requests + weighted routing canary.

Omar (Skyline): Appreciate the proactive reach. Our main worry is any change that touches hallucination or response semantics. We do a lot of structured responses.

Lena (Optimize Eng): Understood. We can do a post-train int8 (opt-qt) and build a compact variant (redwood-compact-lite). We will run the customer's eval harness and a lightweight semantic/regression suite. Typical bench: int8 -> ~1.6x throughput; latency p95 often drops ~20-35%.

Diego (Infra): I can create a canary pool. Suggest routing 3-7% traffic for 72h so we get stable tail percentiles without risking majority traffic. Need the eval set (+redaction) and the success criteria.

Priya (CSM): Success criteria suggestion:
- Intent-F1 delta <= 2% absolute
- Hallucination rate <= 1.3x baseline
- No increase in API error rate > 0.5%
- p95 latency improvement >= 15%
If any of the first three fail, auto-rollback. Logs to customer KMS S3.

Lena (Optimize Eng): I'll add an automated quality check step. We'll compute intent-F1 and a simple slot-exact match for structured outputs. Also include a synthetic adversarial sample set to surface hallucination regressions.

Diego (Infra): Sample routing policy to create in the Console:
```json
{
  "name": "skyline-compact-canary",
  "variant": "redwood-compact-lite",
  "weight": 0.05,
  "duration": "72h",
  "monitors": {"intent_f1_threshold": 0.98, "max_error_rate": 0.005, "p95_improvement_min": 0.15},
  "rollback_triggers": ["quality_drop","error_rate_spike","sev_incident"]
}
```

OpsBot: Ticket CS-5122 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-5122 assigned to @Lena and @Diego.

Omar (Skyline): I'll assemble a de-identified eval bundle (2k sessions) and share via secure attachment before EOD. We also want a one-page customer note explaining what the pilot changes and rollback guarantees look like.

Claire (Renewals): Flagged on our renewal tracker. If we show <3% quality delta and clear p95 wins, we can use this as a positive item in the renewal deck. Please cc me on the results doc.

Priya (CSM): Plan & next steps: 1) Omar uploads redacted eval set; 2) Lena builds int8 + compact variant and runs A/B canary at 5% for 72h; 3) collect p50/p95 latency, cost-per-1000-tokens, intent-F1, hallucination metric, error rate; 4) review results in 4 days and decide full rollout. I'll draft the customer-facing summary and runbook.

Lena (Optimize Eng): Scheduling canary build for 09:00 PT tomorrow. Will publish interim metrics in the Console route dashboard and post a link here when live.

Priya (CSM): Thanks team  I'll close the loop once CS-5122 has the runbook.
